4th Period.workingNow: Editing your home page's index.html to add your first name and one image.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub account created, starter repo forked, and GitHub Pages live with your first name and one image on the home page — no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can edit HTML on my home page so that it displays my name and one image, following our PII rules.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas.
agenda: Warm-Up: Review PII rules — what's safe to share? (5 min)
I do: teacher edits index.html live, adds name (8 min)
We do: locate the image tag together, discuss alt text (7 min)
You do: add your first name and one image to your page (22 min)
Peer check: partner confirms no PII is visible (5 min)
Exit Ticket: Commit & push your changes (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday your site went live but was still empty. Today you start actually putting yourself on it — safely. Tomorrow we'll polish this page and get it ready to share.

6th Period.workingNow: Reviewing our Getting to Know You results and browsing classmates' sites to find something in common.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Google Site home page live with a nav menu and one image, and the Getting to Know You survey submitted.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can find something I have in common with a classmate so that I can build community in our class.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.IC.1 — Compare tradeoffs associated with computing technologies that affect people's everyday activities and career options.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: Warm-Up: Getting to Know You results reveal (8 min)
I do: teacher models browsing a site & noting one commonality (5 min)
You do: browse 3 classmates' sites in pairs (20 min)
Discussion post: name a classmate + one thing in common on Google Classroom (12 min)
Exit Ticket: Share one commonality aloud (5 min)
6th Period.connections: Yesterday you told us about yourselves through the survey. Today we use those answers to find things we have in common as a class. Tomorrow we'll wrap up the week and polish our sites.
